# `⍉` — Transpose

`⍉Y` reverses axis order.

```bpl
⍉2 3⍴⍳6            ⍝ [0 3 ⋄ 1 4 ⋄ 2 5]
```

In `A⍉Y`, each item of `A` names the result axis for the corresponding source axis. Labels start at 0 with no gaps.

```bpl
1 0⍉2 3⍴⍳6         ⍝ [0 3 ⋄ 1 4 ⋄ 2 5]
```

Repeated labels select diagonals, taking the smallest participating dimension.

```bpl
0 0⍉3 3⍴⍳9         ⍝ 0 4 8
```
